course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: To find the elevation of the top of a tower of KUET, observations were made from two stations P and R, 30 m apart. The horizontal angle measured at P between R and the top of the tower was $60 ^ { \circ } 3 0 ^ { \prime }$ and that measured at R between the top of the tower and P station was $6 8 ^ { 0 } 1 8 ^ { \prime }$ The angle of elevation to the top of the tower was measured to be $1 0 . 4 8 ^ { 0 }$ at R and that was $1 0 . 1 7 ^ { 0 }$ at P. Staff readings on BM when the instrument was at $P = 1 . 9 6 9 m$ and that with the instrument at ${ \sf R } = 2 . 0 7 3$ m. Calculate the elevation of the top of the tower of KUET if that ofBM was 420 m.

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে উচ্চতা নির্ণয় এবং ভূমি পরিদর্শনের মৌলিক নীতি (Levelling) ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে যা সিলেবাসের প্রথম টপিকে অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটি ট্রিগনোমেট্রিক সূত্র ব্যবহার করে উচ্চতা নির্ণয় (Tachometry/Trigonometrical Levelling) নিয়ে যা 'Levelling' এর চেয়ে বেশি প্রযুক্তিমূলক এবং পুরানো তালিকা থেকে বাদ দেওয়া হয়েছে।
